p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 1000000007
result = 1

if k == 0:
    for _ in range(p - 1):
        result = (result * p) % MOD
else:
    parent = list(range(p))
    size = [1] * p

    def find(x):
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = find(parent[x])
            x = parent[x]
        return x

    def unite(x, y):
        x_root = find(x)
        y_root = find(y)
        if x_root == y_root:
            return False
        if size[x_root] < size[y_root]:
            x_root, y_root = y_root, x_root
        parent[y_root] = x_root
        size[x_root] += size[y_root]
        return True

    cc = p
    for i in range(p):
        to = (k * i) % p
        if unite(i, to):
            cc -= 1

    if k > 1:
        comps = set(find(i) for i in range(p))
        cc = len(comps)

    for _ in range(cc):
        result = (result * p) % MOD

print(result)
